name: Rosewood Sao Paulo
positioning: Rosewood's first South American hotel, built into a former maternity ward in Sao Paulo's Bela Vista neighborhood, with a Jean Nouvel tower and Philippe Starck interiors
best_for: Travelers who want design and commissioned Brazilian art at the center of their stay
Food lovers who want several distinct restaurants and bars under one roof
Observant Jewish travelers who need Shabbat suites and kosher dining

facts.text: The hotel sits in the Bela Vista neighborhood of Sao Paulo, which is home to Avenida Paulista.
Art was commissioned for spaces from the rooftop pool floor to the elevator interiors, primarily from Brazilian artists and makers.
The hotel offers a guided tour of the commissioned works of art within the hotel.
Le Jardin is the hotel's grand cafe, serving from breakfast to late-night bites, with kosher options and garden dining.
Blaise serves French cuisine crafted using Brazilian ingredients.
Taraz centers on wood-fire South American cooking.
Rabo Di Galo offers live music and cocktails.
Bela Vista Bar blends cocktails and Mediterranean flavors.
The hotel's Asaya spa is the first Asaya spa in South America.
Asaya Crystal Room experiences include guided meditations, Reiki and head massages.
Suites include personalized butler service, designer pieces and marble bathrooms.
There are two Shabbat suites on the ground level modified to accommodate observers, and the in-room dining menu has a kosher section.

highlights.text: The hotel is built into a former maternity ward where half a million Paulistas were born.
The restored 1922 Santa Luzia Chapel is crowned by a stained glass rosette by Vik Muniz and hosts weddings and ceremonies.
The interiors were designed by Philippe Starck and the tree-shrouded tower by Jean Nouvel.
Rosewood Sao Paulo is Rosewood's first property in South America.
The main pool has a mosaic floor that evokes the rivers of Bonito, with first-come-first-serve cabanas.

considerations.text: Interior maternity ward rooms around the courtyard can get some noise from the restaurant below.
